title: Primal Houserules
description: Table houserules for dnd5e, each one switched on or off in the settings: a natural 20 on a saving throw takes no damage and a natural 1 takes maximum damage; Armor Class is capped (24 to start with) for everyone; hit points rolled at level up are half the die fixed plus a roll for the other half; spell emanations like Spirit Guardians hit a creature at most once per round (with Primal Auras); an MVP pip beside Inspiration on character sheets; and a Quick Break rest (10 minutes, one Hit Die) beside the short and long rests on dnd5e and Tidy 5e sheets. Works with or without Midi-QOL. Made with AI: written with Claude (Anthropic).

recommends.reason: Spell emanations are limited to once per round through Primal Auras (1.3.0 or later).
The Armor Class cap is added through libWrapper when it's on, so it works alongside other modules.
